proposals.evidence: Full puṣya explicitly gives Torwali pašū, Palula piśīk, Gawri puṣa and Kalasha puṣík flower, distinguishing the ṣṣ development and discussing alternative historical analyses. These directly support the selected survey pūś-/piś- flower forms. Source vowels, sibilant notation and attested k extension remain intact; local transmission and ultimate stem history remain qualified. This is not an automatic puṣpa or phulla assignment. Exact response: piśīk.
